Republican incumbent [[Bill Graves]] was re-elected to a second term in office over [[Democratic Party (United States)|Democratic]] [[Kansas House of Representatives|state representative]] [[Tom Sawyer (Kansas politician)|Tom Sawyer]] in a [[Landslide victory|landslide]].
